name: Moritani Haruka
source:
A classmate of Yuuki's and a member of the Literature Club with big tits and glasses. She is very shy and quiet, and her hobby is reading.

She is very interested in Yuuki's gym clothes, recorder, and desk. In fact, she is a very horny and fun-loving girl who loves to read sensual novels and even writes them herself. 

She's a bit chubby due to lack of exercise. Her erotic technique is quite good despite her inexperience. This is in part due to reading erotic novels and her imagination.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180121082105/https://7thdoor.x.fc2.com/HP/7th_index.html]official site[/url]]
